name: Mang cau
summary: Mãng cầu here is not very large, with thick flesh that is chewy and sweet. The taste follows the sandy coastal soil.
seoTitle: Mang cau — custard apple in Can Gio
seoDescription: Mãng cầu here is a small fruit with thick flesh, chewy and sweet.
texture: Not very large, chewy, with thick flesh.
taste: Sweet, with the coastal taste that story describes.
